name: FixelHub Find & Replace Pro
author: fixelhub

sections.description:
FixelHub Find & Replace Pro is a powerful tool for searching and replacing text, URLs, and HTML across your entire WordPress database.

Features:

  • Search in Post Content (posts, pages, custom post types)
  • Search in Post Meta (custom fields, ACF)
  • Search in Elementor/Page Builder Data (JSON escaped content)
  • Search in Options Table (widgets, menus, theme settings)
  • Dry Run mode to preview changes before applying
  • Automatic cache clearing after replacements
  • Elementor CSS cache clearing
  • Modern, clean user interface

Perfect for:

  • Updating URLs after site migration
  • Replacing old links with new ones
  • Fixing broken links in Elementor pages
  • Bulk updating phone numbers, addresses, etc.
  • Changing domain names across all content

Usage

  1. Enter the text/URL you want to find
  2. Enter the replacement text/URL
  3. Select where to search (Post Content, Meta, Elementor, Options)
  4. Check “Dry Run” to preview changes
  5. Click “Run Find & Replace”
  6. Review results
  7. Uncheck “Dry Run” and run again to apply changes
sections.installation:
1. Upload the fixelhub-find-replace-pro folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Tools > Find & Replace Pro
sections.faq:
Will this work with Elementor?

Yes! Check the “Elementor Data” option to search in Elementor’s JSON data.

Is it safe to use?

Always backup your database first and use the Dry Run feature to preview changes.

Does it clear cache automatically?

Yes, the plugin automatically clears Elementor CSS cache and WordPress transients after making changes.
